_doc: Adventure-map sprites (large unit, 72x88, like the Lost World Chieftain of lost-world-hero) and 48x48 portraits of the six v0.2 hero classes. The faction docs do not say mounted or on foot; decision (bzc.14): every hero rides, as on a Heroes map, and each class has its own mount so a hero never reads as a creature stack: Knight Errant on a chestnut charger, Enchanter on a white unicorn, Revenant on a skeleton horse, Mortician on a grey donkey with funeral plumes, Warlord on a war boar, Weatherwitch on a shaggy goat. Same layers and colours as faction-units (no faction layer, the 2000-character cap). Faces south-east, never mirrored. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: Knight Errant, a chunky cute hero knight with a huge round head riding a big sturdy chestnut horse seen from the front-right, rider and horse filling the whole width of the image: an open-faced light steel helmet with a big crimson plume showing a brave grinning face with a moustache, a crimson surcoat with a gold-yellow cross over light steel mail, a long crimson cape, a light steel sword raised high in the right hand; the horse is warm chestnut with a cream mane and a white blaze and a short crimson saddle cloth with gold-yellow trim; simple shapes; the hooves are the lowest thing.
recipes.negative: lance, caparison, white horse, brown leather

recipes.subject: Subject: Enchanter, a chunky cute storybook enchantress with a huge round head riding a white unicorn seen from the front-right, rider and unicorn filling the whole width of the image: a kind smiling face, long golden hair, a tall pointed crimson cone hat with a flowing cream veil, a crimson and cream gown, a long pale birch wand with a small gold-yellow star and sparkles held up in the right hand; the unicorn is snow white with a cream mane, a gold-yellow spiral horn and a crimson saddle cloth with gold-yellow trim; simple shapes; the hooves are the lowest thing in the image.
recipes.negative: armour, sword, wings, rainbow, pink, purple

recipes.subject: Subject: Revenant, a chunky cute undead knight with a huge round pale ivory skull head riding a skeleton horse seen from the front-right, rider and mount filling the whole width of the image: glowing violet eye sockets, a dented dark iron helmet with a tarnished bronze rim and a ragged near-black plume, dark iron armour, a ragged near-black cape with thin bright violet trim, a big notched light grey iron sword raised; the horse is all pale ivory bones with a bony skull head with violet eyes and a ragged near-black saddle cloth; simple shapes; the hooves are the lowest thing.
recipes.negative: red cloth, green skin, blood, gore, flesh horse, brown horse

recipes.subject: Subject: Mortician, a chunky cute deadpan undertaker with a huge round head riding a gaunt pale grey donkey seen from the front-right, filling the whole width: pale yellowish-white wrinkled skin, a long nose, thin lips, droopy violet eyes, a very tall near-black top hat with a bright violet band, a near-black frock coat with a cream collar, a small tarnished bronze hand bell held up; the donkey is pale grey with long ears, a dark grey mane, a tall near-black funeral plume on its head and a near-black saddle cloth with violet trim; simple shapes; the hooves are the lowest thing.
recipes.negative: skull face, red cloth, green skin, blood, horse

recipes.subject: Subject: Warlord, a chunky cute goblin warlord with a huge round head riding a huge bristly war boar seen from the front-right, rider and boar filling the whole width of the image: bright lime green skin #86c232 with a lighter #acdc55 face, huge pointed ears, a big toothy shouting grin, a dented tin helmet painted hazard yellow #fdd20f with a tall spike, a pale sand-buff fur cape, an oversized jagged tin cleaver raised high; the boar is slate grey with a pale grey belly, big cream tusks, a stiff dark grey mane and a hazard yellow saddle blanket; simple shapes; the hooves are the lowest thing.
recipes.negative: wolf, horse, red cloth, skull, gun, brown leather

recipes.subject: Subject: Weatherwitch, a chunky cute old goblin storm witch with a huge round head riding a big shaggy goat seen from the front-right, rider and goat filling the whole width of the image: bright lime green skin #86c232 with a lighter #acdc55 face, huge pointed ears, a hooked nose, a cackling grin, wild white hair, a dented tin pot hat with a small lightning rod, a hazard yellow #fdd20f shawl, a tin lantern with a crackling yellow spark held up; the goat is pale sand-buff with a cream beard, big curly grey horns and a hazard yellow saddle blanket; simple shapes; the hooves are the lowest thing.
recipes.negative: broom, flying, purple glow, red cloth, skull, gun

recipes.subject: Subject: Knight Errant portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute hero knight: an open-faced light steel helmet with a big crimson plume, a brave grin and a brown moustache, a crimson surcoat with a gold-yellow cross over light steel mail, a crimson cape on the shoulders, the hilt of a steel sword over one shoulder.

Subject: Enchanter portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute storybook enchantress: a kind smile, long golden hair, a tall pointed crimson hat with a gold-yellow band, a crimson and cream gown, a pale birch wand with a small gold-yellow star and sparkles held beside her face.

Subject: Revenant portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute undead knight: a pale ivory skull face with glowing bright violet eye sockets and a toothy grin, a dented dark iron helmet with a tarnished bronze rim and a ragged near-black plume, dark iron pauldrons, a ragged near-black cape with thin bright violet trim.
recipes.negative: horse, red cloth, green skin, blood

recipes.subject: Subject: Mortician portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute deadpan undertaker: pale yellowish-white wrinkled skin, a long nose, thin lips, droopy violet eyes, a very tall near-black top hat with a bright violet band, a near-black frock coat with a cream collar, a small tarnished bronze hand bell held up beside his face.
recipes.negative: skull face, donkey, red cloth, green skin

recipes.subject: Subject: Warlord portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute goblin warlord: bright lime green skin #86c232 with a lighter #acdc55 face, huge pointed ears sticking out sideways, a big toothy shouting grin, a dented tin helmet painted hazard yellow #fdd20f with a tall spike, a pale sand-buff fur cape over the shoulders, a jagged tin cleaver resting on one shoulder.
recipes.negative: boar, red cloth, skull, olive skin

recipes.subject: Subject: Weatherwitch portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute old goblin storm witch: bright lime green skin #86c232 with a lighter #acdc55 face, huge pointed ears, a hooked nose, a cackling grin, wild white hair, a dented tin pot hat with a small lightning rod and a yellow spark, a hazard yellow #fdd20f shawl over the shoulders.
recipes.negative: goat, broom, purple glow, red cloth

recipes.subject: Zoom in to a close-up portrait: redraw it as only the head and the top of the shoulders, twice as big, filling the square: the open-faced light steel helmet with the big crimson plume, the brave grin and moustache, the crimson surcoat with the gold-yellow cross at the bottom edge. Keep the colours, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: knight-errant-portrait-a#0 came back as a small whole figure (LESSONS 4.1 portrait fix).
